matched_group_policy: A: 3 regime-withholding conditions per world, gold invariant, verified per-group; E: 3 temporal episodes per sequence, gold varies by design
duplicate_policy: global fingerprint over {family, asset, gold, condition_id, params-minus-seed}; matched-condition variants (different condition_id) are never collapsed
provenance_policy: every episode retains world_id, matched_group_id, condition_id, asset_id, parameterization, generator_version, schema_version
